thread:
ava: PR 4278: LRU allocator tweak — cuts mem for hot models. Need infra + runtime + security eyes before canary. Short summary below; CC @sofia @jess @randal

sofia: thanks — can you add perf numbers and a quick repro? i'll take runtime review after that.

ava: added quick bench + repro. run:
```
./scripts/bench_mem.sh --model=gpt-small --iters=50
```
sample output: 
`before: rss=2.4G, after: rss=1.95G (18.8% reduction)`
also pushed a small patch to toggle the new allocator via env var.

jess: quick question — the syscall wrapper change (wrap_alloc())? can that be disabled at runtime? security will want an opt-out.

randal: infra note: need to validate pinned mmaps on our node images; this could affect OOM behavior on older kernels. tagging @infra-bot to run mem-smoke.

infra-bot: infra-bot: scheduled mem-smoke job #8821 for PR 4278 (nodes: gpu-pool-3). Will post results as soon as complete.

secbot: secbot: flagged syscall wrapper for security review. Please complete the Security Checklist: <https://redwood.internal/sec/checklist/4278> and attach threat-model note.

ava: added env toggle: `REDWOOD_LRU_V2=0|1` and updated the checklist. Requesting canary window Wed 03:00 UTC. If runtime/infra/sec owners can +1, i'll queue merge.

sofia: looking now, will run the repro and flamegraphs — expect runtime review in ~2h. can you post flamegraphs from the bench?

jess: security ok with toggle + checklist, but need a 3-line threat-model note about syscall exposure. i'll +1 once that's in.

randal: +1 from infra if mem-smoke passes and no regression >5% p95 latency on gpu-pool-3.

ava: uploaded flamegraphs + perf dashboard snapshot: <http://perf.internal/graphs/4278>. Thanks everyone — will follow up with mem-smoke results and the threat-model note shortly.
